items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer:
Most brand and website projects take four to six weeks from kickoff to launch. We agree the milestones up front so you always know what happens next.

n

items.question: Do you work with small businesses?
items.answer:
Yes u2014 we work with founders, small teams and growing companies. There is no minimum project size.

n

items.question: What do you need from us to start?
items.answer:
Your logo files (if you have them), access to your current site, and one decision-maker who can approve work.

n

items.question: Can you work with our existing website?
items.answer:
Often, yes. We audit what you have first. If the platform is holding you back, we will say so plainly instead of patching around it.

n

items.question: Do we own the design files?
items.answer:
Completely. You get the source files, the fonts licence details and a handover walkthrough.
